notes.title: Get an MVP Credit in Nemesis Island
notes.notes:
Find the missing security guard on the island and post a screenshot on our discord server under Special Events. We will then put your name in our credits page as our first MVP!
This is for the first person to find the security guard.
But beware it won't be easy, this island wants you DEAD!
